Metadata.title: DripCatch — Subscription & Shared Expense Tracker
Metadata.description: Track recurring subscriptions, eliminate zombie expenses, detect unexpected price hikes, and split costs seamlessly with friends.

Landing.badge: Take back control of recurring spend
Landing.heroSubtitle: Services raise prices quietly. Trials convert silently. Track your true monthly burn, spot hidden hikes, and trim the dead weight.

features.title: Built for vigilance
features.subtitle: Most budgeting apps show where your money went. We show what is quietly extracting it.
features.hikeDesc: Flag subscriptions that quietly nudged their prices up $2–$5 over the last 12 months.
features.normalizationDesc: See annual, quarterly, and monthly charges leveled into one honest monthly burn rate.
features.zombieDesc: Identify streaming services and SaaS tools you haven't opened in over 45 days.
